[[File:Proton_rifle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers armed with proton rifles]]
'''Proton rifle''' was a variant of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] originally used to hunt big game. During the New Order, this rifle was commonly found in hands of [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]].
